TOPIC 3.4
Differentiating  
Inverse Trigonometric 
Functions

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

FUN-3.E
Calculate derivatives 
of inverse and inverse 
trigonometric functions.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

FUN-3.E.2
The chain rule applied with the definition 
of an inverse function, or the formula for 
the derivative of an inverse function, can 
be used to find the derivatives of inverse 
trigonometric functions.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

FUN-3
Recognizing opportunities to apply derivative rules can simplify differentiation.

SUGGESTED SKILLS 

Implementing 
Mathematical Processes

1.E
Apply appropriate 
mathematical rules or 
procedures, with and without 
technology.
